description: Tailwind utility soup with proper labels and autocomplete; header template search and footer product-updates box.
Material style outlined fields written out, generated ids with colons, no names, controlled inputs, password visibility toggle.
CSS-module classes, labels as adjacent divs, no ids or names, autocomplete off and new-password on a plain log-in; language picker in the footer.
Bootstrap 3 forum, placeholder-only, the secret box is type=text until focused, off-screen spam trap, forum search in the sidebar.
Chakra style markup, aria-label is the only clue on the fields, email in a text input, unusual wording for the secret.
Ant Design style tabs with sign-in active and register panel hidden in the same page.
Client-rendered after a skeleton, unusual identifier wording, controlled inputs on a page that re-renders every second, a help widget that appears with the form.
Bootstrap 5 floating labels; a track-an-order box with its own email comes first in the page, the sign-in second.
Vue scoped attributes, labels wrapping spans, unusual wording for both credentials, an organisation code and an environment picker that are not credentials.
Re-authentication: signed-in account shown as text, one password box, in-app search in the sidebar.
Single-page flow: email input is removed from the DOM and replaced with a chip when the password input is rendered.
Password block is revealed under the email box in the same form; the email box stays visible and editable.
Real page navigation between the username page and the password page; second page keeps the username in a hidden input.
Email-first with the real password input already mounted but collapsed; after Next there is a short check, then the email hides and the password shows.
Bank style: unusual wording for the identifier, security image text on the second step, branch finder in the header on both steps.
Three steps in one page: email, then password, then a six digit two-factor code. styled-components class names.
Tailwind sign-up with names, email, password and confirmation, correct autocomplete; footer newsletter.
Material style fields, controlled inputs with a countdown that re-renders every second, no confirm box, optional referral code.
Bootstrap tabs with Register active on load; the sign-in pane is hidden in the same page. No autocomplete attributes.
Placeholder-only sign-up with terse names and a birthday in three selects.
Rendered after one second, aria-label only, wrong autocomplete values on the new password boxes, company field, team-size select.
CSS-module classes, grid rows of adjacent div labels, no ids or names, casual wording for password confirmation, security question and answer.
Settings page: a profile section with name and email above a password section; navigation search in the side bar.
Reset page reached from a mail link: new password and confirm only, Material style, controlled inputs, account name kept in a hidden input.
CSS modules, adjacent div labels with old/new/again wording, autocomplete off throughout, bullets as placeholders, show buttons.
Accordion on a security page: the password form only exists after opening its section and a short load. Recovery email box in another open section.
Forced expiry page in Ant style, placeholder-only, account shown as text, controlled inputs re-rendering each second, IT help box.
One input with a proper one-time-code autocomplete, numeric input mode and a length limit.
Six separate boxes with Tailwind classes, aria-label per digit, auto-advance and paste handling.
Adjacent div caption, telephone input type, no autocomplete, placeholder of zeros; controlled input re-rendered by a resend countdown; trust-device checkbox.
Four-digit SMS code in four unlabelled boxes; the only text is the heading and the group label.
Split into three and three with a dash, name attributes with array syntax, rendered after a short delay, code delivered by email.
aria-label only, autocomplete off, authenticator wording; a recovery-code form is hidden behind a link.
Swahili sign-in, labels with for, product search in the header.
Thai sign-in, placeholder-only, no names or ids; footer newsletter box in Thai.
Hungarian registration, opaque ids, labels with for.
Greek password change, aria-label only, opaque ids.
Hebrew, right to left, single code box without autocomplete.
Payment step with correct cc autocomplete, input masks on number and expiry; promo code and order note beside it.
Donation form, adjacent div captions, plain wording for card parts, month and year selects, a donation amount box.
Hosted payment fields: number, expiry and CVC each live in their own iframe, name on card is in the page, discount box in the page.
Checkout shipping form with no autocomplete attributes, generated field ids, labels with for; coupon box and delivery note.
Material style floating labels, local wording for address parts, native select for state; discount code and gift message.
Same-origin iframe holds the member sign-in widget; the host page has a programme search and a newsletter box.
Payment challenge: an outer iframe is added after a second and holds a nested iframe with one passcode box.
Web components: a card with an open shadow root containing field components with their own open shadow roots; course search in the light DOM.
Log-in dialog is portalled to the end of body only after clicking the header button; the page behind has a search box and a newsletter box.
A reading wall opens by itself a little after load: Material dialog offering a free account; article behind has a footer newsletter box.
Search results page: header search box, price range filters and a sort select.
Newsletter landing page, Material style, "Sign up" wording, one email box.
Blog post with a comment form asking only for a nickname and a comment, blog search and footer subscribe box.
Loan repayment calculator with four numeric boxes.
Flight search with origin, destination, dates and passenger count.
Basket page: quantity boxes and a short "enter code" promotional box with an Apply button.
Admin table with per-column filter boxes for username, email and role above existing rows.
Free-standing password strength tester: one masked box on a tool page, nothing to log in to, the page says to avoid real passwords.
Webmail compose window with recipient boxes, subject and body, plus mailbox search.
Help article whose text is all about signing in and passwords; only a help search box and a feedback text area.
Product page with a six-digit delivery PIN code checker and a quantity box.
Signed-in dashboard: invite a teammate by email with a role select, and workspace search.
